definitions.explanation: The muscles of the abdomen. Often used in fitness and health contexts.
Short for the exercise that works the abdominal muscles. Used colloquially to refer to the exercise itself.

examples.japanese: {腹筋|ふっきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
{腹筋|ふっきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{割|わ}れている→割れる：00907_wareru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{憧|あこが}れる→憧れる：05302_akogareru⟧。
examples.english: I admire people with defined abs.

notes:
USAGE: {腹筋|ふっきん} has two common uses. As an anatomical term it refers to the abdominal muscles, and in everyday speech it often refers to the sit-up exercise itself.

The expression {腹筋|ふっきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{割|わ}れる→割れる：00907_wareru⟧ (abs are split/divided) means to have a visible six-pack.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {腹筋|ふっきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧: to train one's abs
- {腹筋|ふっきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{割|わ}れる→割れる：00907_wareru⟧: to have defined abs (six-pack)
- {腹筋|ふっきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do sit-ups
- {腹筋|ふっきん}⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧: abdominal exercises
